If those conditions appear later, you can re-enter with fresh perspective; if they don't, the EXIT was the right call. **STOP-LOSS**: $0.0666 — if price closes below this level, the thesis is broken; exit without averaging down further. The stop is set by the brain based on technical support and ATR-derived volatility — it's the line where the math says 'we're wrong here'.
